title: A signed Roos coordinate model gives the derived-limit triangle
statement: Let C be an abelian category with countable products and exact countable products, finite binary biproducts, and a chosen unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let K(n+1) to K(n) be a tower of cochain complexes and put B equal to its product and u equal to one minus its transition shift [def-weil-category-product]. Suppose a complex L is given with degreewise isomorphisms L^i to B^i direct sum B^(i-1), with differential (x,y) to (dx,ux-dy), and a chain map p:L to B that is the first coordinate. Then the product of the Q(K(n)) exists, and there are arrows q:Q(L) to this product and delta from this product to Q(L)[1] forming the derived-limit triangle [def-weil-derived-limit] for the actual localized tower transitions. For every n, q followed by the nth projection equals Q of p followed by the original nth projection.

proof.text: Use the first coordinate and negative second coordinate to define a map from L to the native mapping cocone of u. The displayed differential is precisely the chain-map equation. The matrix is invertible degreewise, and its composite with the native first projection is p.

The localized product cone is limiting by exact countable products. Identify it with the chosen product of the localized tower. Checking projections shows that this isomorphism conjugates Q(u) to one minus the localized transition shift.

The localized native mapping-cocone triangle is distinguished. Transport it along the coordinate isomorphism and the product comparison. Its first arrow is Q(p) followed by that comparison, so the claimed projection equations follow.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedLimitTriangle_of_roos_coordinates
    [HasCountableProducts C] [CountableAB4Star C] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} C]
    (K : ℕ → CochainComplex C ℤ) (f : ∀ n, K (n + 1) ⟶ K n)
    (L : CochainComplex C ℤ)
    (e : ∀ i : ℤ, L.X i ≅ (∏ᶜ K : CochainComplex C ℤ).X i ⊞
      (∏ᶜ K : CochainComplex C ℤ).X (i - 1))
    (hd : ∀ i : ℤ, L.d i (i + 1) ≫ (e (i + 1)).hom =
      (e i).hom ≫ biprod.lift
        (biprod.fst ≫ (∏ᶜ K : CochainComplex C ℤ).d i (i + 1))
        (biprod.fst ≫ (towerTransitionEndomorphism f).f i ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg (∏ᶜ K : CochainComplex C ℤ).X
            (Int.add_sub_cancel i 1).symm) -
          biprod.snd ≫ (∏ᶜ K : CochainComplex C ℤ).d (i - 1) ((i + 1) - 1)))
    (p : L ⟶ ∏ᶜ K) (hp : ∀ i, p.f i = (e i).hom ≫ biprod.fst) :
    ∃ _hP : HasProduct (fun n ↦ DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.obj (K n)),
      ∃ (q : DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.obj L ⟶ ∏ᶜ (fun n ↦ DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.obj (K n)))
        (δ : (∏ᶜ (fun n ↦ DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.obj (K n))) ⟶
          (DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.obj L)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
        IsDerivedLimitTriangle (fun n ↦ DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.map (f n))
          (DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.obj L) q δ ∧
        ∀ n, q ≫ Pi.π _ n = DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.map (p ≫ Pi.π K n)
